result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a high-visibility marked crosswalk and curb ramps. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing is uncontrolled and lacks mid-block refuge or signalization to manage vehicle speeds on the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without the protection of a signal or stop sign on the primary roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The width of the travel lanes may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the background

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a marked continental crosswalk across a two-lane road, but it lacks any accompanying signage or traffic control devices. While a sidewalk and greenery are present, the environment lacks traffic calming measures to protect pedestrians at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: A marked crosswalk exists without any stop signs, traffic signals, or pedestrian warning signs to alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing across the two-lane road

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway design with minimal vertical elements may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install W11-2 pedestrian crossing signs with diagonal downward pointing arrows (W16-7P) to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed arterial roadway with multiple lanes and a wide grassy median, completely lacking pedestrian infrastructure. There are no visible sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals at this signalized intersection, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks and marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the intersection and along the roadside.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing the risk and severity of potential collisions.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian countdown signals to the intersection to facilitate safe crossings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Utilize the existing median space to create paved refuge islands, reducing the unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked zebra crosswalk within a residential context. However, the environment lacks traffic calming measures, and the pavement shows signs of wear and cracking near the crossing area.

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The corner radius on the left appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra crosswalk markings are visible but show signs of wear, reducing their contrast and visibility to drivers.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt in the roadway near the crossing area.
